{{Top}}
A '''black box''', also known as a '''flight recorder''', was a piece of equipment installed aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that logged the events aboard ship, providing a record of the ship's functions and recorded data. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], logs from the flight recorder aboard the ''[[FarStar]]'' helped to determine that [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]] was the victim of an attempted [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] perpetrated by [[the Wraith]].

Black boxes were commonly installed on starships conducted [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] missions. As [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessels]] often conducted "blind jumps"&mdash;[[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps into unknown [[Realspace/Legends|space]]&mdash;they commonly got lost. Black boxes logged the data from each jump, allowing the starship to retrace its path if necessary.
